```yaml
name: Check Discord Link Health

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 12 hours (at minute 0 of hour 0 and 12)
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-discord-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check Discord Invite Status
        id: check
        run: |
          INVITE_CODE="f2AjwV2AN"
          URL="https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/${INVITE_CODE}"
          
          echo "Checking Discord invite: ${URL}"
          
          # Use curl to check the invite status
          # We expect a 200 OK if the invite is valid
          HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "${URL}")
          
          echo "HTTP Status: ${HTTP_STATUS}"
          
          if [ "${HTTP_STATUS}" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "Discord invite is valid."
            echo "status=valid" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Discord invite is invalid or expired (Status: ${HTTP_STATUS})."
            echo "status=invalid" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Issue if Link is Invalid
        if: steps.check.outputs.status == 'invalid'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const label = 'discord-link';
            const title = 'Discord Invite Link is Invalid';
            const body = `
              The Discord invite link (discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN) appears to be invalid or expired.
              
              **Action Required:**
              - Verify the current Discord invite link.
              - Update the link in \`README.md\` and \`src/render-table.js\` if necessary.
              - Close this issue once fixed.
              
              *This issue was automatically created by the Discord Link Health Check workflow.*
            `;

            // Check for existing open issues with the same label
            const existingIssues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: label
            });

            if (existingIssues.data.length > 0) {
              console.log('An open issue with label "' + label + '" already exists. Skipping creation.');
              return;
            }

            // Create new issue
            await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: title,
              body: body,
              labels: [label]
            });

            console.log('Created new issue: ' + title);
```
